nautical.roles: Boats go to the point on the water; land units stop at the meeting point on the road, where the boat brings the rescued.

coastGuard.title: A boat is needed — the Coast Guard steps in
coastGuard.titleCovered: Your boats are not enough — the Coast Guard steps in
coastGuard.covers: {provider} handles the rescue on the water ({list}).
coastGuard.shore: Send your land units to the meeting point.
coastGuard.noCoastGuard: The Coast Guard does not work on rivers and lakes: you need a boat of your own, which gets there on its trailer.

requirements.waterHint: boats and aircraft, at the emergency point
requirements.shoreHint: land units, at the meeting point

route.BANK: on its trailer, launched from the bank

dispatch.landAtWater: Brings nothing needed at the meeting point: the rescue on the water needs a boat
dispatch.boatOnLand: A boat cannot reach an emergency on land

shop.title: Where boats are kept
shop.body: Boats are kept only at a marine base, in a harbour, on the seafront or on a lake. On the same water they leave straight from their berth; rivers and other lakes are reached on a trailer.
shop.none: You do not have a marine base yet.
shop.berths: {free, plural, =0 {Berths full} one {# free berth of {total}} other {# free berths of {total}}}
shop.legacyMove: {count, plural, one {One boat is still at a fire station: move it to the marine base for free.} other {# boats are still at a fire station: move them to the marine base for free.}}
shop.legacyKeep: {count, plural, one {One boat is still at a fire station: it keeps working, and with a marine base you can move it for free.} other {# boats are still at a fire station: they keep working, and with a marine base you can move them for free.}}
shop.noFacility: You need a marine base: boats are not kept at fire stations.
shop.noBerth: Berths full: extend the pier of your marine base.

site.listHint: Harbours, seafront and lakes: the only place to open a marine base and keep boats.
site.mapHint: {count, plural, =0 {No nautical site nearby} one {# nautical site: tap it for the marine base} other {# nautical sites: tap one for the marine base}}
site.berths: {count, plural, one {# berth} other {# berths}}, up to {max} with the pier
site.hosts: Hosts the boats of the Fire Brigade, EMS and Police
site.berthOnWater: Berth on the water: boats leave from here

facility.title: Marine base
facility.howItWorks: On the same water boats leave straight from their berth; rivers and other lakes are reached on a trailer, up to a launch point. The pier adds berths.

transfer.offer: Move to the marine base for free
transfer.hint: This boat is still at a fire station: move it to {facility} for free.
transfer.noBerth: Boat still at a fire station: free a berth or extend the pier to move it to the marine base for free.
transfer.noBase: Boat still at a fire station: it keeps working. With a marine base you can move it for free.
transfer.onlyAvailable: It moves once it is available at its facility.
transfer.boatOnly: Boats are kept only at a marine base

errors.NEEDS_NAUTICAL_BASE: Boats are kept only at a marine base: buy one on a nautical site.
errors.NAUTICAL_SITE_REQUIRED: A marine base can only open on a nautical site: a harbour, the seafront or a lake.
errors.NO_ROOM_WATER: Berths full at this marine base ({used} of {total}): extend the pier.
errors.NO_ROOM: No free space at this facility ({used} of {total}): {upgrade}.
errors.INCOMPATIBLE_FACILITY: This facility cannot host this vehicle.
